title: Rito leri humaka eka Xihlahla lexi Pfurhaka
intro: Pfuxeta vutivi bya munhu loyi a dzikeke loyi riendzo ra yena ri sunguleke hi ku hlangana hi singita naswona vumundzuku bya yena byi hlanganisiwile na ku ntshunxiwa ka vanhu lava tshikileriweke. Munhu loyi u hlawuriwile entirhweni lowukulu, a langutane ni mintlhontlho leyikulu hi nseketelo wa Xikwembu.
clues: Ndzi velekiwe enkarhini wa ntshikilelo lowukulu, laha tincece ta vanhu va mina a ti dlayiwa.
Vutomi bya mina byo sungula a byi katsa ku vekiwa enambyeni hi mutswari wa mina, hambiswiritano ndzi kumiwe ni ku kurisiwa endyangwini wa mutshikeleri wa vanhu va mina.
Ndzi tshame ndzi baleka edorobeni endzhaku ko vanga rifu ra munhu un’we handle ko swi xiya hi nkarhi wa mpfilumpfilu.
Ndzi kume rungula leri humaka eka Xikwembu ni nhonga ya singita endhawini yo kwetsima, laha ndzi lerisiweke ku langutana ni mufumi wa matimba.
Makwerhu wa mina u thoriwile tanihi mupfuni eka mina eka vurhumiwa bya mina, hikwalaho ka xihinga lexi a xi voniwa eka mbulavulo wa mina.
Ndzi rhangele vanhu va mina va tsemakanya lwandle leri avaneke, ndzi balekela ku hlongoriwa hi vuthu ra tihanyi.

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: Ku langutana na Faro ni vangoma va yena
Ku lovisiwa ka vanhu va le Thamudi
trial.answer: Ku langutana na Faro ni vangoma va yena

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: Faro ni vuthu rakwe va nwile
Marhangu ya muti ma wile hikwalaho ka xirilo
outcome.answer: Faro ni vuthu rakwe va nwile

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verse: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]." (20:77)
